source_map.short_description: Main orientation workspace displaying operational case throughput and derived lifecycle states without running ML.
Presents and validates the 7 non-laboratory screening predictors, rendering the sanitized Input Review State.
Authoritative controller executing frozen GAM inference, saving ScreeningRecord and ScreeningExplanation, and issuing PRG 302.
Renders screening probability, signal badge, GAM-native additive attributions, and human review forms from persisted DB records.
POST endpoint capturing pseudonymous reviewer code and deriving final referral matching AI recommendation.
POST endpoint capturing reviewer code, branch-specific override reasons, and deriving opposite referral decision.
Enforces final referral gating and presents the laboratory HbA1c entry form.
POST endpoint revalidating HbA1c, deriving ADA 2026 range server-side, and persisting Stage2Assessment.
Operational task queue partitioning actionable cases into Pending Review, Pending Stage 2, and Needs System Attention.
Auditable ledger displaying exactly one row per ScreeningRecord with server-side filtering, search, and pagination.
Computes and displays aggregate workflow metrics, transition matrix, and selective verification safeguards.
Methodological documentation page displaying frozen GAM specification, held-out benchmarks, and research caveats.
Visual component inventory for design system QA; suppressed in study mode.
Legacy Phase D1 patient data input view; unlinked and dead code.
Legacy Phase D1 multi-model inference and SHAP calculation; unlinked and dead code.
Immutable historical domain entity for Stage-1 non-lab screening inputs, AI output, and model checksums.
1:1 entity storing GAM spline additive decomposition, link intercept, and reconstruction error.
1:1 entity capturing pseudonymous reviewer code, review action (accepted/overridden), and final referral.
1:1 entity capturing confirmatory laboratory HbA1c percentage and server-derived ADA reference range.
Legacy Phase D1 integer-keyed model storing 8 features including lab values and multi-model strings.
Legacy Phase D1 doctor override entity storing doctor_name and prediction replacement values.
Authoritative contract defining valid clinical/research bounds and canonical ordering for the 7 predictors.
Django Form enforcing server-side validation against STAGE1_INPUT_SCHEMA domain bounds.
Thread-safe service executing frozen PyGAM inference at threshold 0.1389 with SHA256 integrity verification.
Evaluates exact GAM-native partial dependence splines on log-odds scale with <= 1e-10 fidelity verification.
Pure functional precedence evaluator deriving the 6 lifecycle workflow states from relational entity presence.
Pure Decimal classifier mapping HbA1c to ADA 2026 reference cutoffs (<5.7% Normal, 5.7-6.4% Prediabetes, >=6.5% Diabetes).
Pure read-only aggregator generating workflow rates, 2x2 decision transition matrix, and override distributions.
Legacy Phase D1 SHAP KernelExplainer module; completely decoupled from active Stage-1 screening.
Legacy Phase D1 loader caching Keras DLNN and multi-model variants; decoupled from active Stage-1 screening.
